purpose: Construct the blocked declarative representation of the quantitative-measures candidate while preserving the exact scientific decision set.

required.statement: Validate the exact feature identity, required opaque input, source object, canonical provenance, and exact three-reference decision set.
Preserve TLC-SO-PRACTICE-022, input and output identities, opaque payload, reservations, traceability, and scientific decisions.
Keep structural construction, validation, canonical serialization, deserialization, comparison, and trace inspection available despite blocked metric evaluation.

forbidden.statement: Do not infer or compute a frequency unit, session interval, observation window, accuracy denominator, efficiency resource arithmetic, threshold, scale, or exact metric value.
Do not alter the exact decisions, invent temporal, progression, or effect semantics, or publish partial success.

deferred.statement: Scientific metric evaluation is deferred to scientific review and execution requires an external executor.

operations.purpose: Return the immutable blocked metric-candidate representation or a stable structured error.

constraints.statement: The required value is supplied under candidate status and remains opaque, including an empty but present payload.

preconditions.statement: INPUT-PRACTICE-008-1 and TLC-SO-PRACTICE-022 are present with canonical provenance.
The scientific decision set is exactly TLC-SO-PRACTICE-022, TLC-SR-PRACTICE-021, and TLC-HR-0101.

postconditions.statement: The object, opaque payload, output reference, reservations, provenance, and all three decisions remain exact and traceable.
Blocked metric evaluation does not block successful structural representation.

invariants.statement: The exact three-reference decision set is neither shortened nor extended.
No unit, interval, observation window, denominator semantics, resource arithmetic, scale, threshold, exact value, progression, or effect is inferred.

steps: validate identity input provenance and exact decisions
preserve opaque value and blocker set

partial_order.before: validate identity input provenance and exact decisions
preserve opaque value and blocker set

prescription_basis: Exact blocker propagation, opaque preservation, deterministic structure, and atomic publication are observable; internal sequencing is open.

error_contract.condition: Source error id invalid_feature_identity: the feature id is not TLC-FC-13-PRACTICE-008.
Source error id missing_required_input: INPUT-PRACTICE-008-1 is absent.
Source error id invalid_input_type: the required value is not opaque.
Source error id missing_source_reference: the object or a decision lacks its canonical reference.
Source error id provenance_mismatch: identity, provenance, or the exact decision set differs from authority.
Source error id structural_error: the declarative representation violates this contract.
Source error id scientific_decision_required: metric evaluation is requested before the exact decisions are resolved.
Source error id external_executor_required: scientific execution is requested without an external executor.
Source error id implementation_out_of_scope: undeclared frequency, duration, ratio, resource, validation, or effect semantics are requested.

implementation_modes.statement: Expose the blocked declarative representation while preserving the exact decisions.
Do not compute frequency, accuracy, efficiency, or any quantitative metric before future scientific authority.
Internal architecture remains free when all observable obligations are preserved.

global_invariants.statement: Blocked metric evaluation never invalidates an otherwise valid structural representation.
Decision identity, candidate status, scientific opacity, and traceability cannot be weakened.

dependencies.purpose: Stable object, input, output, and decision identities

notes: Conformance is structural; quantitative metric semantics remain unresolved.
